question: Saudi Arabia leads the world in export of petroleum in 2018-19. Which country holds the second position?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saudi Arabia leads the world in the export of petroleum in 2018-19. Russia, Iraq, and the USA hold the second, third, and fourth positions respectively. Hence, Option 3 is correct**
 
• **More than half of the world's proven oil reserves are located in the Middle East (including Iran but not North Africa).**
 
• Canada, the United States, Latin America, Africa, and the region occupied by the former Soviet Union contain less than 15 percent of the world's proven reserves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil Fields in Russia**

 
 
• Russia is thought to possess the best potential for new discoveries.
 
• It has significant proven reserves of 5 percent of the world total—and is the **world’s leading petroleum producer.**
 
• There are two supergiant oil fields – Western Siberia and Yenisey Khatanga.
 
• **Kamchatka peninsula** and **Sakhalin Island** are said to have significant oil reserves.
 
• Volga-Caspian Region has many oil and gas fields.
 
 
 
• **Oilfields in Saudi Arabia**
 
 
• **Saudi Arabia has the second-largest proven oil reserves (Venezuela has the largest proven oil reserves).**
 
• Approximately 20 percent of the world’s proven reserves.
 
• The discovery that transformed Saudi Arabia into a leading oil country was the **Al-Ghawar oil field.** (still has 70 billion barrels after 60 years of production)
 
• Another important discovery was the **Saffaniyah offshore field in the Persian Gulf.** It is the third-largest oil field in the world and the **largest offshore.**
